description: In false ? [1] : true ? [2] : [3] the second conditional is the false result
notes: The spec's grammar (Conditional = Expression "?" Expression ":" Expression) allows both groupings of a conditional after the colon, and no rule chooses one. hashicorp/hcl parses the condition without conditionals and the false result as a whole expression, so conditionals nest to the right (parseTernaryConditional in hclsyntax/parser.go). The tuples rule out the other readings: grouping to the left, or stopping after the first conditional, would have to unify a tuple with a bool.
